summary: If the registry uses an internal or self-signed CA, install-dynamic-plugins fails with 'x509: certificate signed by unknown authority'. Create ConfigMap registry-ca-crt from the full CA chain and mount it in that init container at /etc/containers/certs.d/<registry-host>[:port] so skopeo trusts it.
questions: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority in install-dynamic-plugins
How do I make the portal trust a self-signed mirror registry?
Where do I mount the registry CA for skopeo?
Registry CA with a non-standard port in certs.d

answer_card.title: Fix x509 errors in install-dynamic-plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
cat registry.crt intermediate.crt root.crt > ca-bundle.crt
oc create configmap registry-ca-crt --from-file=ca.crt=ca-bundle.crt -n <namespace>
```
```yaml
redhat-developer-hub:
  upstream:
    backstage:
      extraVolumes:
        - name: registry-ca-crt
          configMap:
            name: registry-ca-crt
      initContainers:
        - name: install-dynamic-plugins
          volumeMounts:
            - name: registry-ca-crt
              mountPath: /etc/containers/certs.d/<registry-host>
              readOnly: true
```
`mountPath` is the registry host only, plus port if non-standard (e.g. `mirror.example.com:5000`).
